deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

entry_route.value: Direct BS entrants need 72 credit hours beyond the BS, while MS entrants get a 30-hour block toward the same 72.
entry_route.quote: A student entering with a MS degree will receive a block of 30 credit hours toward the total 72-hour program requirement

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog states no funding policy.

notes: The catalog page has no GRE or English rule, so the university rules apply. Bioengineering is run through the chemical and biochemical engineering department.
